name: Cloud Nine Cleanser
short: Whipped oat milk cleanser for a soft reset.
description: A cushiony, low-foam cleanser that melts away the day without taking your glow with it. Oat milk, panthenol, and chamomile leave skin fresh, calm, and cloud-soft.

name: Dew Drop Serum
description: A bouncy daily serum with multi-weight hyaluronic acid and a brightening trio. Wear it alone or layer under your favorite moisturizer for an instant dew effect.

name: Pink Cloud Moisturizer
short: Plush hydration with a featherlight finish.
description: This silky gel-cream sinks in fast, then keeps the good stuff in. Ceramides, squalane, and pink algae help skin feel comfortably juicy all day.

name: Sun Day SPF 40
short: Invisible daily SPF with a juicy finish.
description: Broad-spectrum SPF 40 that feels like skincare, not sunscreen. The non-greasy formula blends clear and leaves a fresh, happy-skin finish.
ingredients: Zinc oxide · vitamin E · sea buckthorn

name: Smooth Operator
short: Gentle lactic acid for a brighter tomorrow.
description: A once-a-week exfoliating treatment that smooths texture with a soft touch. Lactic acid, mandelic acid, and allantoin keep the ritual effective and kind.

name: Jelly Bean Lip Mask
description: A plush lip mask with raspberry seed oil and shea butter. It melts on contact, stays put overnight, and wakes up with you in the morning.
ingredients: Shea butter · raspberry oil · vitamin E

name: Green Room Mist
description: A fine mist of cucumber water and centella for moments when skin needs a breather. Keep it on your desk, in your tote, or beside your yoga mat.

name: Lavender Lullaby Oil
short: A calming face oil for soft landings.
description: A silky blend of jojoba, meadowfoam, and lavender to seal in moisture during your evening wind-down. A little goes a long way.

name: Vitamin Sea Drops
short: A vitamin C drop for your morning glow.
description: A stable vitamin C serum with ferulic acid and sea minerals. Designed to brighten the look of dull skin without the sting.
ingredients: Vitamin C · ferulic acid · sea minerals

name: Bathing Beauty Bar
short: A creamy face bar with a clean conscience.
description: A solid cleansing bar made with coconut-derived surfactants and a hint of calendula. It lathers into a creamy cloud and travels beautifully.

name: Cool Girl Eye Gel
short: A cooling eye gel for brighter-looking mornings.
description: A quick-absorbing gel with caffeine, cucumber, and peptides for the look of rested, refreshed eyes whenever you need a little lift.

name: Soft Focus Clay Mask
short: A creamy clay mask that never feels tight.
description: A soft kaolin and oat mask that helps clarify the look of pores while keeping skin cozy. Ten minutes, then rinse into a fresh start.

name: Body Glow Lotion
short: A pearly body lotion for everyday radiance.
description: A fast-absorbing body lotion with mango butter and a subtle pearl finish. Smooth, soften, and shimmer into your day.

name: The Tiny Joy Set
short: Four little rituals, one very happy face.
description: A mini routine for trying the Elice essentials: Cloud Nine Cleanser, Dew Drop Serum, Pink Cloud Moisturizer, and Sun Day SPF.
